lang.name: English
app.name: Posthouse
app.tagline: Shared, versioned memory for all your AI agents
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Enter the admin password to manage workspaces.
common.name: Name
ws.title: Workspaces
ws.empty: No workspaces yet. Create one, or let an agent create one through MCP or the skill.
ws.nameHint: Letters, digits, . _ - (any language). Example: paper-2026 or 论文项目
ws.passwordHint: Optional. Anyone with this password can read and write this workspace only.
ws.template: Add the standard layout (AGENTS.md, STATUS.md, DECISIONS.md, journal/, memory/, files/)
files.selectFile: Select a file on the left, or create a new one.
files.binary: Binary file ({size}). Download it to view.
files.deleteConfirm: Delete '{path}'? It stays recoverable from history.
files.conflict: This file was changed by someone else since you opened it.
files.leave: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
settings.passwordSet: This workspace has its own password.
settings.passwordUnset: This workspace has no password of its own; only the admin and agent passwords can open it.
settings.compactHint: History is compacted automatically every day. Nothing is deleted; every old version stays available.
settings.compactHintHours: History is compacted automatically every {hours} hours. Nothing is deleted; every old version stays available.
settings.compactHintOff: Automatic compaction is off (POSTHOUSE_GIT_GC_HOURS=0). Nothing is deleted; every old version stays available.
settings.deleteText: Moves the workspace to the trash. Connections and tokens limited to it are revoked.
settings.deleteConfirm: Type the workspace name to confirm
connect.title: Connect agents
connect.intro: Every agent reaches this server through MCP (web apps, CLIs) or the REST API (the skill / curl). Pick the method your app supports.
connect.oauthTitle: Option A — Sign in with a password (recommended)
connect.oauthText: Add the MCP URL as a custom connector / app. When the app opens the sign-in page, enter a password. Leave Workspace empty for full access, or enter a workspace name to limit the connection to it.
connect.tokenTitle: Option B — Secret URL with a token
connect.tokenText: For apps that only accept a URL with no sign-in: create a token and use the URL that contains it. Anyone with the URL has access, so keep it private and revoke it when done.
connect.headerTitle: Option C — Header (CLI agents, Claude request headers)
connect.skillText: Agents with a shell (Claude Cowork, Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) can use the bundled skill or plain curl.
connect.promptTitle: Starter prompt for a new conversation
connect.prompt: You can use the "Posthouse" connector. Our project lives in the workspace "{ws}". First call start_session(workspace="{ws}") and read AGENTS.md and STATUS.md. Keep STATUS.md current and call log_progress before you stop.
connect.createToken: Create a token for this workspace
connect.claude: Claude (web/desktop/mobile): Settings → Connectors → Add custom connector.
connect.chatgpt: ChatGPT (web): Settings → Security → turn on Developer mode, then Apps/Plugins → + (Add). Select it in each new chat.
connect.gemini: Gemini (web, where available): Settings → Connected apps → Add a custom app.
connect.cli: Claude Code: claude mcp add --transport http posthouse {url} — Codex / Gemini CLI: add the URL to the MCP settings file (see docs).
tokens.title: Access tokens
tokens.intro: Tokens are revocable credentials for agents. Use them as 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' or inside the secret MCP URL.
tokens.created: Token created — copy it now, it will not be shown again.
tokens.urlWithToken: MCP URL with token (no sign-in needed)
tokens.nameHint: Shown as the author of changes, e.g. ChatGPT
tokens.revokeConfirm: Revoke token '{name}'? Apps using it will lose access.
conn.title: Connected apps
conn.intro: Apps that signed in through OAuth (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini…). Revoke to disconnect.
activity.title: Activity
trash.title: Trash
trash.intro: Deleted workspaces. Restore them or delete them forever.
trash.purgeConfirm: Permanently delete '{name}'? This cannot be undone.
oauth.title: Authorize access
oauth.wants: {client} wants to read and write your workspaces.
oauth.loopback: This app runs on a local computer. Only allow it if you started it yourself.
oauth.help: Admin or agent password: leave Workspace empty for full access, or enter a workspace name to limit this connection to that workspace. Workspace password: enter that workspace's name.
